name: Form FDA 3500B - MedWatch Voluntary Reporting for Consumers/Patients
fields: A1 What kind of problem was it?
A2 Did any of the following happen?
A4 Tell us what happened, how it happened or why it happened
B1 Do you still have the product in case we need to evaluate it?
B2 Do you have a picture of the product?
C1 Name(s) of the product as it appears on the box, bottle, or package
C1 Place and Date of Purchase
C2 Check if therapy/usage is on-going
C3 Name(s) of the company that makes (or compounds) the product
C11 How was it taken or used
C12a Date the person first started taking or using the product
C12b Date the person stopped taking or using the product
C12c Date the person reduced dose of the product
C13 Give best estimate of duration
C14 Why was the person using the product?
C15 Did the problem stop after the person reduced the dose or stopped taking or using the product?
C16 Did the problem return if the person started taking or using the product again?
E6 What is your race and/or ethnicity?
E9 List any other important information about the person
E10 List all over-the-counter medications and any vitamins, minerals, supplements, and herbal remedies being used
E11 List all current prescription medications and medical devices being used
F10 Did you report this problem to the company that makes the product?
F11 If you do NOT want your identity disclosed to the manufacturer place an X
notes: Encrypted XFA PDF, 8 pages, created 2025-09-15; mail: MedWatch Program, White Oak Campus, Building 22, G0207, 10903 New Hampshire Ave., Silver Spring, MD 20993; fax 800-332-0178; questions 1-800-332-1088; Spanish edition https://www.fda.gov/media/122470/download?attachment; /media/76299 is Form FDA 3500 for health professionals, not 3500B
